name: Anika Sharma
psychographics: Creative multitasker; loves discovering new apps but gets overwhelmed by notifications and often turns her phone off after 7 PM.
current_solutions: FamiSafe for screen time limits; Woolworths supermarket app with 'click and collect'; Spotify Kids for car rides.
frustration: At 7:30 PM, tried to approve a school permission slip on her phone, the app timed out, auto-logged her out, and she lost the draft, having to re-fill it at 8:15 PM while making dinner.
decision_style: Impulse-buys based on Instagram ads if the visual is appealing; often regrets the purchase two days later.
voice: Casual and slang-heavy; sprinkles 'like,' 'totally,' and 'honestly' throughout; uses uptalk.
